name: Lambance Rig
text:
Exhaust (use 1 flash): Choose a path card. That card gains illumination until the end of the turn.
[FOC] + [reason] (use 1 flash): Distract with a brilliant flash of light to exhaust a being.

name: "Lucky" Cloak
text:
Exhaust: When you would suffer 1 or more fatigue, draw a challenge card and resolve the following effect based on its icon:
[sun] Soothe that amount of fatigue instead.
[mountain] Prevent that fatigue.
[crest] Suffer 1 additional fatigue or discard this gear.

name: A Frog this Way Comes
text:
Choose one:
Exhaust X path cards.
Shuffle a path card with X or less presence into the path deck. Then search the General set for a Fractal Frog and shuffle it into the path deck.

name: The Shapeshifter
text:
Friendly. Persistent. Unique.
Exhaust: Shuffle a being attached to this biomeld into the path deck. If that being was a predator, add 3[harm] to another being. If it was a prey, add 4[progress] to another being. Otherwise, exhaust another being.
If there is not a being attached to this biomeld, it gains the following test:
[AWA] + [connection]: Suggest a new form to attach a non-human being from the path discard facedown to this biomeld. Then exhaust this biomeld.

name: Grasp of the Verdessa
text: Manifestation. <f>(To play a manifestation, discard 1 token from a conduit.)</f><hr>Add 1 [harm] to a flora to place a path card on top of the path deck. If that card is a biomeld, place it on the bottom of the path deck instead.

name: Silaro's Fastidiousness
text:
Attach to a Ranger's equipped gear.
Response: After a Ranger succeeds at a test from the attached gear, if it cleared a being, scout 1 path card. If it cleared a feature, add 2[progress] to the location. Otherwise, scout 1 Ranger card.

name: Fate of the Reclaimers
text: If you have a weapon equipped, add 3 [harm] to a being. It fatigues you. If it fatigues you for 2 or more, add 2 additional [harm].
flavor: The reclaimer invasion has reached its nadir, and they appear to be dying off. You wonder, however, if they have simply gone dormant and will one day return.

name: Rebreather
text:
Setup.
Exhaust (use 1 filter): When you interact with a water card, commit 2 effort.
This gear cannot be discarded or returned to your hand by path card effects.

name: Gus the Mole
text:
Friendly. Persistent. Unique.
Exhaust: Look at the top card of the path deck. Add [progress] equal to its presence to another path card in play that shares its card type.
[FIT] + [connection]: Nuzzle your little friend to ready this being and soothe 1 fatigue.

name: Portable Generator
text:
Attach to a feature.
Exhaust: The attached feature gains illumination until the end of the turn. Then, if it's a machine, add 1 unique token to it.
flavor: You took this device from Orlin's Vault not knowing how truly useful it would be.

name: Wanderer Spirit
text:
Friendly. Persistent. Unique. Spirit.
[FOC] + [exploration]: Navigate [2] alongside the spirit to add [progress] to this being equal to your effort. Then you may move your [ranger] to a feature in the same area.
mountain_challenge: You may exhaust this spirit to move up to 3 [progress] from it to the location.

name: Expedition Logbook
text: [FOC] + [exploration] (use 1 entry): Consult observations on the arcology to add 1[progress] to a feature for every 2 effort. If that feature is a ruin or machine, add [progress] equal to your effort instead. Then, read [guide] 197.

name: The Ambition of the Estians
text: Move a feature. It fatigues you. Then add [progress] to that feature equal to your fatigue.
flavor: The Estian's vision for their arcology was grand. Not only could it house hundreds of thousands, but its inhabitants were tasked with inventing new technologies that would preserve their legacy.

name: Ren Kobo's Hat
text:
Unique.
Exhaust: When you suffer 1 or more fatigue, add an equal number of [progress] to the location.
Response: If you have 1 or less fatigue, discard this gear.

name: As Above, So Below
text: Each Ranger can move their [ranger] to a being, feature, or the location.
flavor: After exploring every inch of the subterranean chambers of the arcology, and encountering no small number of wondrous beings, you've come to understand that there is no place on Earth that is not home to multitudinous life, be that under the sun, or below its surface.

name: Lunn's Door Opener
text:
Setup.
Exhaust (use 1 cell): When you interact with a machine, commit 2 effort.
[FOC] + [reason] (use 1 cell): Interface with a device to add 1 unique token to a machine for every 2 effort.

name: Stripe, Loyal Lutrinal
text:
Friendly. Persistent. Unique.
Exhaust: Discard 3[progress] from this being to resolve a challenge effect on a being.
[AWA] + [exploration]: Chase [2] the scampering lutrinal to add 1[progress] to a feature for every 2 effort. Then add an equal amount of [progress] to this being and move it.

name: Carried by the Wind
text:
Manifestation.
Attach to a feature or location.
When you Traverse the attached card, dodge all obstacles. If you fail, prevent the injury and return this manifestation to your hand.

name: Archivist Spirit
text:
Friendly. Persistent. Unique. Spirit.
[SPI] + [reason]: Reflect [2] on the spirit's wisdom to add [progress] to this being equal to your effort. Then scout 1 challenge card.
crest_challenge: You may exhaust this spirit and discard 3 [progress] from it to place all fatigue you suffered this test on the bottom of your Ranger deck.

name: Call the Scuttlebus
text: Response: Before you decide to travel, if there is 2[per_ranger] or more [progress] on the location, you may travel (regardless of the location's [progress] threshold). If there is 5[per_ranger] or more [progress] on it, travel to a location up to two paths away. Use the terrain of the second path when building the path deck.

name: Quisi's Lantern
text:
While this card has at least 1 gleam remaining, within reach is illuminated.
Exhaust (use 1 gleam): When you perform a test, dodge each card within reach.
flavor: You hold the lantern aloft and "Slugmond" squirms, emitting a warm glow.

name: Echoes of the Estians
text:
Attach to a path card.
Exhaust: When a Ranger performs a test that interacts with the attached card, commit 2 effort. This test can be performed without commiting energy.
flavor: You can sense the presence of the Estians all around you, their hands shaping the present through the medium of the past.

name: Repellent Spores
text:
Setup.
Exhaust (use 1 puff): When you interact with a flora, commit 2 effort.
[FOC] + [reason] (use 1 puff): Release a cloud of spores to exhaust a flora.

name: Bursting with Life
text: Manifestation.<hr>Choose a flora and either remove 1 [harm] from it or add 2 [progress] to it. Then add 4 [progress] to a non-biomeld being in the same area as the chosen flora.
flavor: Ever since you delivered the mysterious seed to its destination, you have discovered a new kinship with the Valley's plant life, and a new source of wisdom.

name: Memlev Hammock
text:
Deployed: When you add 1 or more [progress] to a being, increase the [progress] added by 1. When you add 1 or more [progress] to a feature, decrease the [progress] added by 1. This gear gains the following ability:
Response: When you rest, soothe 2 fatigue.

name: Mycelial Incense
text:
You can Connect with flora features.
Exhaust: After you successfully Connect with a flora, soothe 1 fatigue. If that flora has the mycelial keyword, add [progress] equal to your effort to each other flora with the mycelial keyword.

name: Gardener Spirit
text:
Friendly. Persistent. Unique. Spirit.
[FIT] + [connection]: Tend [2] to the land alongside the spirit to add [progress] to this being equal to your effort. You may discard 1[harm] from a feature. If it is a flora, soothe 2 fatigue.
sun_challenge: You may discard 3[progress] from this spirit and exhaust it to choose a nature card in your discard and add it to your hand.

name: The Audacity of the Estians
text: Choose a Ranger to soothe all of their fatigue. Then that Ranger places an equal number of cards from their hand facedown on top of their fatigue stack in any order.
flavor: The Estians feared no limitation and heeded no boundary; as evidenced by the biomelds that yet roam the Arcology ruin.

name: Flowsteel Lithophone
text: Exhaust (use 1 tune): After you play a moment or attachment, soothe 1 fatigue. If that card is a tale, gain 1 energy matching that card's aspect.
flavor: Crafted by Tollin Lang, this lithophone is capable of rich, vibrating tones that resonate deep within, supplying listeners with a profound sense of well-being.

name: Crimson Guardian
text:
Obstacle. Disconnected.
Response: When there is no power on this being, discard it.
[FIT] + [conflict]: Grapple [2] with the guardian to move this machine and discard 1 power from it.
sun_challenge: If this being has 1 or more [harm], <f>it repairs itself.</f> [right_arrow] Discard all [harm] and 1 power from it.
crest_challenge: If you have 2 or more fatigue, exhaust this being. [right_arrow] Discard 1 power from this being and suffer 1 injury.

name: The Heart's Anger
text:
Attach to The Heart.
FIT + conflict: Release [2] the heart's anger to attach this emotion to a different organ.
sun_challenge: Discard 1 power from an attached organ, or attach this emotion to The Heart.
crest_challenge: If this emotion is attached to The Heart, <f>it lashes out.</f> >> Each Ranger suffers 2 fatigue.

name: Fractal Frog
text:
Ambush.
Clear [progress] or [harm]: [guide] 150
sun_challenge: <f>The frog hops away.</f> Shuffle this being into the path deck.
mountain_challenge: If there is an active predator, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] to this being equal to that predator's presence.
crest_challenge: <f>One frog becomes two!</f> Search the General set for a Fractal Frog and shuffle it into the path deck.

name: Shifting Rubble
text: Obstacle.<hr>While this feature is attached to another card, [progress] cannot be added or moved to that card.
mountain_challenge: If this feature isn't attached, <f>it collapses.</f> [right_arrow] Attach this feature to the path card with the highest presence. If you can't suffer 1 injury.
crest_challenge: Add 1 [harm] to the attached card.

name: Spore Cloud
text:
Response: After you clear the attached card, attach it facedown to the Spore Specimens mission.
Response: When there are no spores on this attachment, discard it.
Replace all challenge effects on the attached card with the following:
sun_challenge: Move this card and discard 1 spore from the attached Spore Cloud.
crest_challenge: If you have 3 or more fatigue, exhaust this card. [right_arrow] Suffer 1 injury and discard 1 spore from the attached Spore Cloud.

name: The Heart (Expanded)
text:
This feature cannot leave play except when you travel or it is discarded by the campaign guide.
Response: After this feature flips. exhaust it. Then resolve and discard each attached challenge card. Then ready this feature.
Clear [harm]: [guide] 140
sun_challenge: Draw and attach 1 challenge card to this organ. If there are 3 or more, <f>it contracts.</f> [right_arrow] After all [sun] effects have resolved, flip this card.

name: Crimson Guardian
text:
Obstacle. Disconnected.
Response: When there is no power on this being, discard it.
[FIT] + [conflict]: Grapple [2] with the guardian to move this machine and discard 1 power from it.
sun_challenge: If this being has 1 or more [harm], <f>it repairs itself.</f> [right_arrow] Discard all [harm] and 1 power from it.
crest_challenge: If you have 2 or more fatigue, exhaust this being. [right_arrow] Discard 1 power from this being and suffer 1 injury.

name: Fractal Frog
text:
Ambush.
Clear [progress] or [harm]: [guide] 150
sun_challenge: <f>The frog hops away.</f> Shuffle this being into the path deck.
mountain_challenge: If there is an active predator, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] to this being equal to that predator's presence.
crest_challenge: <f>One frog becomes two!</f> Search the General set for a Fractal Frog and shuffle it into the path deck.

name: Trial of Ooze
text:
While this clue is attached to a being, that being gains persistent and [progress] cannot be added or moved to this clue.
Response: When the attached being is cleared, [guide] 153.8
Clear [progress]: [guide] 153
crest_challenge: If this clue is attached to a being, <f>it takes a new shape.</f> [right_arrow] [guide] 153.7

name: Prototype (Expanded)
text:
This feature cannot leave play except when you travel, it clears, or by the campaign guide.
Response: After this feature flips, exhaust it. Then resolve and discard each attached challenge card. Then ready this feature.
sun_challenge: Draw and attach 1 challenge card to this organ. If there are 2 or more, <f>it contracts.</f> [right_arrow] After all sun effects have resolved, flip this card.

name: Decrepit Station Platform
text:
Powered [4]: This feature gains Illumination. Reduce its presence to 0.
[FOC] + [exploration]: Locate nearby landmarks on the station map to search the Arcology or Artery set for any one card and attach it facedown to the location. After you travel, put the attached card into play.
sun_challenge: If this feature is illuminated, <f>the light reveals the tunnel ahead.</f> [right_arrow] Scout 1 path card.

name: The Chimney
text:
Response: When you interact with this location, dodge all illuminated cards.
If the CHIMNEY IS SETTLED, it gains: [AWA] + [exploration]: Search the vaulted walkways to scout path cards equal to your effort, then draw 1 path card.
arrival_setup: Lead Ranger: If you traveled to this location from Spire, search the path deck for The Spiral Stairway and put it into play. Otherwise, search the path deck for The Plinth and put it into play. Then read the journal entry for that card.

name: Severed Artery
sun_challenge: If within reach is not illuminated, <f>you lose track of your surroundings.</f> [right_arrow] Discard 1 [progress] from an active feature.
path_deck_assembly: Randomly choose and shuffle only 2 cards from the Artery set into the path deck.
arrival_setup: Lead Ranger: Search the path deck for the next feature and put it into play. Next Ranger: Draw a path card.

name: Prototype (Contracted)
text:
This feature cannot leave play except when you travel, it clears, or by the campaign guide.
Response: After this feature flips, exhaust it. Then resolve and discard each attached challenge card. Then ready this feature.
sun_challenge: Draw and attach 1 challenge card to this organ. If there are 2 or more, <f>it expands.</f> [right_arrow] After all sun effects have resolved, flip this card.
crest_challenge: Move 1 power from one machine to another. Then add 1 [harm] to this feature.

name: The Heart (Contracted)
text:
This feature cannot leave play except when you travel or it is discarded by the campaign guide.
Response: After this feature flips. exhaust it. Then resolve and discard each attached challenge card. Then ready this feature.
Clear [harm]: [guide] 140
sun_challenge: Draw and attach 1 challenge card to this organ. If there are 3 or more, <f>it expands.</f> [right_arrow] After all [sun] effects have resolved, flip this card.
crest_challenge: Move 1 power from one machine to another. Then add 1 [harm] to this feature. [right_arrow] Spend 1 AWA or suffer 1 injury.

name: Branching Artery
sun_challenge: If along the way is not illuminated, <f>you lose your way.</f> [right_arrow] Discard 2 [progress] from the location. If you cannot, suffer 1 fatigue.
arrival_setup: Lead Ranger: Search the path deck for the next feature and put it into play. Next Ranger: Draw a path card.

name: Terminal Artery
text: Refresh: Randomly choose 1 of the remaining cards from the Artery set and shuffle it into the path deck.
path_deck_assembly: Randomly choose and shuffle only 1 card from the Artery set into the path deck.
arrival_setup: Lead Ranger: Draw a path card. Next Ranger: Draw a path card.

name: Mycelial Conclave
sun_challenge: Discard 1 [harm] or 1 [progress] from an active flora.
arrival_setup: Lead Ranger: Search the path deck for the next flora and put it into play. Next Ranger: Draw a path card.

name: The Verdant Sphere
text: All Snapping Maws gain the Obstacle keyword and trait.
arrival_setup: Lead Ranger: Search the path deck for the next flora and put it into play. NExt Ranger: Search the path deck for the next machine and put it into play.

name: Arboretum of Memory
text: [SPI] + [reason]: Reflect [2] on your memories and experiences to return a card from your hand to your collection. Choose a starting moment or attachment from your collection that you meet the aspect requirement for and add it to your hand. (This alteration to your deck is permanent.)
arrival_setup: Lead Ranger: Search the path deck for the next flora and put it into play. Next Ranger: Draw a path card.

name: Talpid's Squeeze
text:
If there are 1 or more debris on this location, you cannot travel.
[FOC] + [conflict]: Disassemble [2] the pile of collapsed rubble to discard 1 debris from this location for every 2 effort.
mountain_challenge: If there is at least 1 debris on this location, <f>the debris shifts.</f> [right_arrow] Discard all [progress] from an active feature. If at least 2 [progress] was discarded, discard 1 debris.
arrival_setup: Lead Ranger: Draw a path card. Next Ranger: Draw a path card. Next Ranger: Draw a path card.

name: Drenching Chamber
text: Response: When a ranger performs a Traverse test on this location, they may spend 1 energy of any type and trudge through the waist-deep water to commit 1 effort.
arrival_setup: Lead Ranger: Search the path deck for the next feature and put it into play. Next Ranger: Search the path deck for the next feature and put it into play.

name: Oasis of Sunlight
text: All areas are illuminated unless a Ranger has fewer than 10 cards remaining in their Ranger deck.
path_deck_assembly: Randomly shuffle 3 cards from the Woods set into the path deck.
arrival_setup: Lead Ranger: Draw a path card. Next Ranger: Draw a path card.

name: Desert of Endless Night
text:
Refresh: Flip one path card that is not illuminated facedown. It keeps any attachments.
Treat facedown cards as features with a presence of 2. If a facedown card is illuminated, flip it faceup.
arrival_setup: Lead Ranger: Draw a path card, it comes into play facedown along the way. Next Ranger: Draw a path card, it comes into play facedown along the way.

name: Cerulean Curtain
mountain_challenge: <f>The pounding waterfall drenches everything around you.</f> Exhaust a card within reach, than either exhaust your role or suffer 1 fatigue.
arrival_setup: Lead Ranger: Draw a path card.

name: Orlin's Vault
text: [FOC] + [exploration]: Tinker [2] with the ancient Estian equipment to add 1 unique token to an equipped tech for every 2 effort.
arrival_setup: Lead Ranger: Draw a path card.

name: Scuttler Network
mountain_challenge: If within reach is not illuminated and there is no active Juvenile Spindlescuttler, <f>something scuttles toward you.</f> [right_arrow] Search the Cave System set for a Juvenile Spindlescuttler.
arrival_setup: Lead Ranger: Search the path deck for the next predator and put it into play. Next Ranger: Search the path deck for the next feature and put it into play.

name: The Cistern
text: [SPI] + [exploration]: Drink [2] of the effervescent waters to soothe 1 fatigue for every 2 effort.
arrival_setup: Lead Ranger: Draw a path card. Next Ranger: Draw a path card.

name: Silent Dormitories
sun_challenge: <f>The spirits of this place stir.</f> Either discard 2 [progress] from a feature to soothe 1 fatigue, or suffer 1 fatigue to add 2 [progress] to a feature.
arrival_setup: Lead Ranger: Draw a path card. Next Ranger: Draw a path card.

name: Carbonforged Maze
text:
Response: When you Traverse this location, reduce the amount of [progress] added by 1 unless your [ranger] is on this location.
[AWA] + [conflict]: Squeeze [2] through the narrow tunnels to move your [ranger] to this location.
arrival_setup: Lead Ranger: Draw a path card. Next Ranger: Draw a path card.

name: Inverted Forest
text:
Response: When you perform a common test, if your [ranger] is on this location, commit 1 effort.
[FIT] + [reason]: Climb [2] to the footbridge to move your [ranger] to this location and scout 1 path card for every 2 effort. If you fail, suffer 1 injury.
arrival_setup: Lead Ranger: Draw a path card. Next Ranger: Draw a path card. Next Ranger: Draw a path card.

name: The Rootway
text: Refresh: Before readying cards, if there are no ready flora, search the path deck and discard for the next flora and put it into play.
arrival_setup: Lead Ranger: Search the path deck for the next flora and put it into play. Next Ranger: Search the path deck for the next flora and put it into play.

name: The Cage
text: [AWA] + [exploration]: Explore [2] the chamber to scout path cards equal to your effort, then draw a path card.
arrival_setup: Lead Ranger: Search the General set for The Heart and put it into play, Expanded side faceup. Then, draw a path card. Next Ranger: Draw a path card.

name: Saber Beetles
text:
Response: When this swarm is exhausted by a prey's [mountain] effect, add 1 beetle to it.
You can add a maximum of 1 [harm] per test to this swarm.
X is equal to the number of beetles on this swarm.
crest_challenge: If you have less FOC energy than this swarm's presence, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Suffer 1 injury.

name: Wild Scuttlebus
sun_challenge: <f>The scuttlebus scampers away.</f> Move this being along the way.
mountain_challenge: <f>The scuttlebus draws near.</f> Move this being within reach. [right_arrow] It fatigues you.
crest_challenge: If you have 2 or more fatigue, <f>the scuttlebus pounces.</f> [right_arrow] Suffer 1 injury.

name: Kal Iver, Proficient Ranger
text:
Friendly.
Response: When there is 3 or more edge on this being, [guide] 144.7.
Clear [progress] or [harm]: [guide] 144
sun_challenge: Add 3 [progress] to the feature with the most [progress]. If this clears it, <f>Kal gains an edge over you.</f> [right_arrow] Add 1 edge to this being.
crest_challenge: If there is an active predator, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] to this being equal to that predator's presence.

name: The Heart's Fear
text:
Attach to The Heart.
[AWA] + [exploration]: Discover [2] the root of the heart's fear to attach this emotion to a different organ.
sun_challenge: Discard 1 power from an attached organ, or attach this emotion to The Heart.
crest_challenge: If this emotion is attached to The Heart, <f>its fear manifests.</f> [right_arrow] Add 1 [harm] to each feature and being.

name: Overgrown Passage
text:
[progress] cannot be added or moved to this feature except by a Ranger with an equipped Repellent Spores.
Clear [progress]: You will be able to travel from this location along routes locked by the [buck] icon. [guide] 157

name: Overgrown Vestiges
text:
Obstacle.
if this feature is illuminated, it loses Obstacle and gains the following test: [AWA] + [exploration]: Discover something useful in the overgrowth to search your Ranger deck for a gear and add it to your hand.
mountain_challenge: If this feature is illuminated <f>the way becomes clear.</f> [right_arrow] Add 1 [progress] to it.

name: Timid Talpid
text: Clear [progress]: Scout 1 path card.
sun_challenge: If this being is illuminated, <f>it borrows away.</f> [right_arrow] Draw 1 path card, then shuffle this being into the path deck.
mountain_challenge: If there is an active predator, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [progress] to it and [harm] to this being, both equal to that predator's presence.

name: Capacitive Leech
sun_challenge: Discard 1 unique token from a machine or tech. [right_arrow] Add 1 power to this being.
mountain_challenge: If there is an active predator, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add 2 [harm] tp it and [harm] to this being equal to that predator's presence.
crest_challenge: Powered [3]: Discard 3 power from this parasite. [right_arrow] Suffer 1 injury.

name: Humming Circuits
text:
Powered [1]: This machine gains Illumination.
[FOC] + [reason]: Redirect the current to discard power up to your effort from this feature to add an equal number of unique tokens to a machine or tech. If you fail, suffer 1 injury.
sun_challenge: Powered [1]: Add 1 power to the machine with the least power.

name: Snapping Maw
mountain_challenge: If this predator is illuminated, <f>it unfurls its toothy petals.</f> [right_arrow] Discard 1 [progress] from it.
crest_challenge: If you have 1 or more fatigue, exhaust this being. [right_arrow] Suffer 1 injury.

name: Prismatic Mushrooms
text:
Illumination. Mycelial.
[AWA] + [exploration]: Discover another glowing patch of mushrooms to add 1 [harm] to this feature and move it to another area.
sun_challenge: <f>The soft light is a relief from the encroaching darkness.</f> You may exhaust a Ranger card to soothe 1 fatigue.
mountain_challenge: If there is an active prey, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [progress] to it and [harm] to this feature, both equal to that prey's presence.

name: Elevated Passage
text:
[AWA] + [exploration]: Spot [3] an alternate route to a higher strata to move your [ranger] to this feature.
Response: When you travel, if each Ranger has their [ranger] on this ruin, [guide] 155.1
mountain_challenge: If there are active features with 3 or more total presence, <f>the passage becomes obstructed.</f> [right_arrow] Remove your [ranger] from this ruin.

name: Vagus Capacitor
text: [FIT] + [reason]: Climb up to the capacitor's connectors to move your [ranger] to this feature and add power to it equal to your effort.
mountain_challenge: If your [ranger] is on this feature, <f>you reroute the connections.</f> [right_arrow] Move 1 power from one machine to another.
crest_challenge: If your [ranger] is on this feature, <f>it shocks you!</f> [right_arrow] Suffer 1 injury unless you discard [per_ranger] power from this feature.

name: The Heart's Sorrow
text:
Attach to The Heart.
[SPI] + [reason]: Reflect [2] on the heart's trauma to attach this emotion to a different organ.
sun_challenge: Discard 1 power from an attached organ, or attach this emotion to The Heart.
crest_challenge: If this emotion is attached to The Heart, <f>it's grief is draining.</f> [right_arrow] Discard 1 power from each card in play.

name: The Heart's Confusion
text:
Attach to The Heart.
[FOC] + [connection]: Guide [2] the heart past its shock to attach this emotion to a different organ.
sun_challenge: Discard 1 power from an attached organ, or attach this emotion to The Heart.
crest_challenge: If this emotion is attached to The Heart, <f>confusion reigns.</f> [right_arrow] Shuffle 2 random cards from the path discard into the path deck.

name: The Plinth
text:
Response: When 1 or more [progress] is added to this feature, if it is illuminated, double that [progress].
[ranger] cannot be moved to this feature except by its test.
If the CHIMNEY IS SETTLED, this feature gains the following test. [AWA] + [exploration]: Browse the available equipment to move your [ranger] to this feature.
Clear [progress]: [guide] 120
sun_challenge: If within reach is not illuminated, <f>you stumble in the dark.</f> [right_arrow] Suffer 1 fatigue.

name: Juvenile Spindlescuttler
text: Disconnected.<hr>If this predator is illuminated, it loses Disconnected.
sun_challenge: Add 2 [harm] to the active feature with the highest presence. If that feature is a flora, add 2 [progress] to this being.
crest_challenge: If this being is illuminated or if you have 3 or more fatigue, exhaust this being. [right_arrow] Suffer 1 fatigue.

name: Spindlescuttler Matron
text:
Disconnected.
If this predator is illuminated, it loses Disconnected.
Clear [harm]: Search the path deck and discard for the next Juvenile Spindlescuttler and place it on top of the path deck.
sun_challenge: Add 3 [harm] to the active feature with the highest presence. If that feature is a flora, add 2 [progress] to this being.
crest_challenge: If this being is illuminated or if you have 2 or more fatigue, exhaust this being. [right_arrow] Suffer 1 injury.

name: Burdened Archelon
text: Enters Play: Search the path deck and discard for the next flora and attach it faceup to this predator.
sun_challenge: If this being has an attached flora, <f>it strains under its burden.</f> [right_arrow] Add 1 [harm] to this being and discard all [progress] from it.
crest_challenge: If you have 1 or more fatigue, <f>the archelon snaps at you.</f> [right_arrow] Suffer 1 injury.

name: Vengeful Stalactites
text:
Obstacle.
If this feature is illuminated, it loses Obstacle.
Clear [harm]: Each Ranger with less [AWA] energy than this feature's presence suffers 1 injury.
crest_challenge: Add 1 [harm] to this feature.

name: Venerable Lightbringer
text: Powered [1]: This machine gains Illumination.
sun_challenge: Powered [1]: If there is an active feature, discard 1 power from this being. [right_arrow] Add 1 [progress] to that feature. Then move this being.
